rows.en: ...So this is Alien Baltan.
Ultraman, so you've come to me of your own accord.
You've saved me the trouble.
Ultraman, thanks to you and your kind, many of my brethren have been turned to space dust.
Protecting peaceful planets from invasion is our mission!!
You who scheme to invade Earth have no right to say that!!
Protecting Earth from invaders is our mission!!
That was to protect the Earth!!
Who are invaders like you lot to talk!!
Silence!! Now, at last, I'll have my revenge!!
Curse you...!!
...But this is not over. Ultraman... prepare yourself...!!
...Alien Baltan. He'll surely show up again.
...Alien Baltan. He'll surely show up again.
...Alien Baltan. He'll surely show up again.
...Alien Baltan. Is he going to appear before us again?
You plan to challenge us again? Fine! Bring it on!!
Just then, Pigmon appeared.
Au-au-au!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
YOU ALL. WHAT HAPPENED WITH ALIEN BALTAN?
Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
Hikari...!! So that's how it is.
Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
Hikari...!! So that's how it is.
Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
I AM GRATEFUL!!
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
It's all thanks to your info, Pigmon.
Pigmon, Captain Zoffy said he'd award you the title of Special Member of the Hero Team.
I SEE. I AM GLAD TO HAVE BEEN OF USE.
I WILL CONTINUE TO COOPERATE WITH YOU FROM NOW ON.
THEN I WILL GO INVESTIGATE ANOTHER CUBE. WE WILL MEET AGAIN.
With that, Pigmon went off somewhere.
Fo, fo, fo, fo, fo...
...!? You're... Don't tell me, Alien Baltan!?
Ultraman isn't here? Then I have no business with you.
...The bastard vanished. Looks like we'd better bring Ultraman along.
Completed the quest "A Strange Visitor".
A kaijin hunting for RX is reportedly in Begins Cube's West District. Take RX and investigate.
You can hear the voices of someone fighting nearby.
Heading toward the voices, you find a familiar figure there.
Help meeee-piiii!!
Pigmon!
So you came, RX.
You!! Skullma of the Kaima Yokai Clan!!
Skullma! Let Pigmon go!
Too bad, RX. I won't hand this one over so easily.
Arr-Ex!
But if you become my hostage in its place, I'll release Pigmon!
Ngh! You coward, Skullma!
Well, what'll it be? This one's life is in your hands.
It's obviously a trap!
Let go-piii!
What'll you do, RX!?
...All right. I'll be your hostage instead.
That's RX for you. You're a reasonable man.
Hey! Are you seriously saying that!?
I know it's a trap. But if I don't become the hostage, Pigmon's life is in danger.
I'm coming over to you now! So let Pigmon go!
Very well. I'll let Pigmon go.
Piiiiiih!!
Pigmon!
Fool! You fell for it!
Pigmon!!
Raaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!
Hahahahahahahahaha!! I said I'd let it go, but I never said I'd spare its life!
How dare you take Pigmon's life!!
I won't forgive you!! I'll never forgive you, Skullma!!
At that moment, something mysterious happened.
Tears of anger and sorrow unleashed Black RX's hidden power.
